gbm_population_evidence.quote: Low Grade Glioma; High Grade Glioma
MAPK Inhibition Combined With Anti-PD1 Therapy for BRAF-altered Pediatric Gliomas

candidate_evidence.quote: Here, investigators will combine MAPK inhibition with anti-PD1 therapy in recurrent, refractory low grade BRAF-altered glioma and newly diagnosed or recurrent BRAF-altered or NF-altered high grade glioma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: High-grade glioma that is newly diagnosed or recurrent
Patients with histologically confirmed diagnosis of pediatric low-grade glioma harboring a BRAFV600 mutation that is recurrent or progressive OR

role_evidence.quote: this will be the first pediatric study evaluating the combination of these agents.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: MAPK pathway inhibition combined with anti-PD1 checkpoint blockade
arms: Dabrafenib + trametinib combined with nivolumab (Cohort B)
